summary: By March 2024, Howard voted against Redwood City's ceasefire resolution, stating the measure could deepen local divisions and that international affairs fell outside the council's role. CAIR-SFBA's tracker separately lists her as opposing the resolution, though it notes the entry is not a verified roll-call transcript. Her recorded reasoning invoked local-governance boundaries rather than expressing a position on Israel's military conduct in Gaza.
